Kwenye skrini inayofuata utachora au kupakia Poligoni ya Mpaka Mbaya kwa ajili ya mradi wako.
Poligoni hii inapaswa kuwa na eneo lako lote unalopenda. GEM itaamua kiotomatiki mpaka halisi kwa kubandika ufuo unaopatikana ndani ya poligoni mbaya.

Hakuna kitu nje ya poligoni hii mbaya kitakachojumuishwa katika uchanganuzi. Unaweza pia kufafanua maeneo ya kutengwa kutoka kwa uchanganuzi au Mikoa Ndogo ya kushughulikiwa tofauti wakati wa uchanganuzi.

CRA zinaweza kuchukua juhudi kukusanya kwa ajili ya eneo lako, na zinapaswa kuwa faili za umbo zenye viwanja vya mraba (vilivyopangwa kwa pikseli) mita 70-85 kwa kila upande ambavyo vina mifano ya maeneo yako tofauti ya uainishaji (Mikoko, Sio Mikoko, Maji n.k.). Zaidi ya hayo, lazima kuwe na sifa inayotoa jina la darasa la kila njama, na sifa nyingine ya nambari inayotoa nambari inayohusiana na darasa kwa kila njama.

Viungo vyako 4 (vya kisasa na vya kihistoria, kwa wimbi kubwa lililoonekana (HOT) na wimbi la chini kabisa lililoonekana (LOT)) vinafaa kwa madhumuni ikiwa:
• Kuna tofauti inayoonekana katika viwango vya wimbi kati ya wimbi kubwa na la chini kwa viungo vya kisasa na vya kihistoria.
• Tafuta tambarare zilizo wazi za wimbi katika kiungo cha LOT, ikiwa zipo. Hizi zinapaswa kuwa ndogo au kufunikwa kabisa na wimbi linaloingia katika mchanganyiko wa HOT.
• Ufuo wa pwani unaweza kuwa umehamia kidogo ndani ya bara katika mchanganyiko wa HOT.
• Maeneo yaliyo wazi ya matope kati ya mikoko yanaweza kuonekana kuwa na unyevu zaidi au hata kama maji katika mchanganyiko wa HOT.

• Maji katika mifereji ya mito na karibu na mito yanaweza kuwa bluu nyeusi zaidi katika mchanganyiko wa HOT (ikionyesha maji ya kina), huku bluu nyepesi zaidi katika mchanganyiko wa LOT (kutokana na maji machafu ambayo yanashikilia mashapo zaidi ya pwani).
• Hakuna pikseli zinazokosekana (idadi ndogo sana ya pikseli zinazokosekana katika maeneo ambayo mikoko haiwezekani kuwa sawa).

Do you have Classification Reference Area (CRA) shapefiles to upload (or uploaded already)?
Yes, I already have CRA shapefile(s).
No, and I\'d like to create my CRAs using this App.

It is time to import or create Classification Reference Areas (CRAs)!

These are polygons within which are a small number of pixels that represent a land cover class (Closed Canopy Mangrove, Open Canopy Mangrove, Terrestrial Forest, Exposed Water etc.).

These polygons are then uploaded to Google Earth Engine and used to train a classifier that can then classify all the pixels in the imagery from your AOI. It typically requires 20-30 or more example CRAs per class to get good results from the classifier, although this app makes currently sets no hard requirement.

Even CRA is typically a 3x3 square containing 9 pixels from your imagery. This means for Sentinel-2, the square is approximately 30x30m, and for Landsat 90x90.
On the next few screens you will be asked to import CRAs or reuse pre-existing CRAs you have imported in the past.

On the next screen you will be able to create CRAs by panning and zooming a map that has both satellite imagery and false color composite layers.

In the center of the screen will be a polygon of an appropriate size, although it may be quite small when you zoom out.

Position this polygon over an area representing Mangrove (Closed/Open), Terrestrial Forest, Other Vegetation, Freshwater Vegetation, Barren Exposed land or Residual Water. Tap the plus button in the lower right to select the area inside the polygon as one of your CRAs and you will be asked to choose the land cover class.

When you have finished choosing CRAs, you can select the checkmark button in the lower right to submit these CRAs and move on to the classification.

You can change the shape of the polygon in the center of the screen by tapping the polygon button in the lower right.
